_instructions: The detection-coverage gate is the share of the authority's ACTUAL amendments that were captured. The denominator therefore cannot come from RegOps: the system can report how many amendments it saw, but not how many it missed, and 'we detected everything we detected' is 100% by construction.

Fill this by going to the authority's own publication listing for the measurement window and writing down every amendment it published for the cell — whether or not RegOps has it. Then rename this file to amendment_ledger.json and re-run `gates`.

Each entry must match the label the harness compares against: '<document title> @ <effective date>', or '<document title> @ 미해석' where the effective date could not be resolved (ADR-0013). The harness reports the missed entries by name, so a near-miss in spelling reads as a detection failure — check the titles against the regulation browser before signing.
Record the window you surveyed. A ledger covering a different window than the `gates --days` run is not a denominator, it is two measurements pretending to be one.
